heading: Appointment of judges
lead: The Secretary may appoint civilian employees of the department in which the Coast Guard is operating as appellate military judges, available for assignment to the Coast Guard Court of Criminal Appeals as provided for in section 866(a) of title 10.

notes.heading: Prior Provisions
notes.text: A prior section 507 was renumbered section 2710 of this title.

notes.heading: Amendments
notes.text: 2018—Pub. L. 115–282 renumbered section 153 of this title as this section.
